INVESTOR AGENTS


Due Diligence: Comprehensive analysis of a company's financial, legal, and operational status to inform investment decisions.

29A Eligibility: Assessment and verification of eligibility criteria for resolution applicants under Section 29A of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

Resolution Planning: Development of strategic plans for restructuring and revitalizing distressed companies.

EOI Submission: Assistance in preparing and submitting Expressions of Interest for potential investors in insolvency proceedings.
